reader_contract: ci16_le, shape (sample, receiver, iq), receiver_ids (0,1); compact rows map to device counter valid_start_counter + local index
utc_policy: UTC is derived only from the host-bracketed device-counter binding and retains the manifest uncertainty; device counter is authoritative for elapsed time.
rf_validity_policy: Counter-word rows are metadata contamination, not RF. Preserve coordinates, exclude estimator/transform windows that touch them, and expand invalidity by filter support. Zero fill is sensitivity analysis only.
source_semantics_limit: The repository reader preserves all stored rows and supplies no row classification. Capture code copies upstream.samples unchanged. Exact firmware/kernel insertion versus overwrite semantics are not attested by the saved manifest; the words occupy one stored IQ row and therefore the original RF values at that coordinate are unavailable.
